# BLOODHOUND — Design Brief
**For: UI/UX Agent | Generated by: PLAN Agent | Date: 2026-02-28**

## 1. Brand Identity System

### 1.1 Color Palette — CONFIRMED

Three colors only: near-black / off-white / blood red. No purple, no blue, no green.

| Token | Hex | Usage |
|---|---|---|
| `--bg-base` | `#0d0a0a` | Primary background — near-black with slight warmth |
| `--bg-surface` | `#141010` | Cards, panels, elevated surfaces |
| `--bg-elevated` | `#1c1616` | Modals, dropdowns, tooltip backgrounds |
| `--border` | `#2a2020` | All borders and dividers |
| `--text-primary` | `#f0eded` | Primary text — off-white with slight warmth |
| `--text-secondary` | `#9e9090` | Secondary labels, metadata, timestamps |
| `--text-muted` | `#5c5050` | Placeholders, disabled states |
| `--accent` | `#b30000` | Blood red — CTAs, active states, seed nodes, alerts |
| `--accent-hover` | `#8a0000` | Hover state for accent elements |
| `--accent-glow` | `rgba(179,0,0,0.12)` | Soft glow on selected nodes, active inputs |

**`[PLAN]`** Exception for status colors only:
- Warning: `#b36a00` (amber) — used only for "Suspected" confidence badges and non-critical warnings
- Success: `#1a7a1a` (dark green) — used only for "Confirmed" badges and uptime indicators
- These are the only additional colors allowed. They do not appear in decorative UI, only in semantic status contexts.

---

### 1.2 Typography — CONFIRMED + EXPANDED

**Fonts:**
- `JetBrains Mono` — all wallet addresses, tx hashes, token amounts, timestamps, code, data values
- `Neue Haas Grotesk` (NHGrotesk) — all UI labels, nav, headings, body copy, buttons

**`[PLAN]`** Loading: JetBrains Mono via Google Fonts. NHGrotesk via Fontshare (free) or Adobe Fonts. Fallback stack: `NHGrotesk → 'Helvetica Neue' → Arial → sans-serif`.

**`[PLAN]`** Type scale:

| Role | Size | Weight | Font | Usage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `display` | 52px | 700 | NHGrotesk | Hero headline only |
| `h1` | 28px | 700 | NHGrotesk | Page titles |
| `h2` | 20px | 600 | NHGrotesk | Section headers, card titles |
| `h3` | 16px | 600 | NHGrotesk | Panel labels, sub-headers |
| `body` | 14px | 400 | NHGrotesk | Body copy, descriptions |
| `small` | 12px | 400 | NHGrotesk | Captions, secondary labels |
| `data-lg` | 18px | 500 | JetBrains Mono | Portfolio totals, key stats |
| `data-md` | 14px | 400 | JetBrains Mono | Wallet addresses, tx hashes |
| `data-sm` | 12px | 400 | JetBrains Mono | Timestamps, minor data values |

**`[PLAN]`** Headline philosophy: large and confident. Section headers in uppercase with `letter-spacing: 0.08em`. Body is mixed case. No centered headlines inside the app — centered only on the landing page hero.

**`[PLAN]`** Weight philosophy: Heavy (700) headlines → medium (500) key data → regular (400) body. Never extra-light. The tool should feel precise, not delicate.

### 1.3 Logo — CONFIRMED

**Icon:** Bloodhound head in left-facing profile. Flat fill, no outline strokes. The eye is a blood red narrowed slit or crosshair — try both, keep whichever reads better at 16px (favicon test). Simple enough to be recognizable as an icon/favicon. Reference images: `360_F_1908436225_BeSPrtxuvrALv0R71FbfHlbFmLZcHHNJ.jpg` and `Screenshot 2026-02-27 165811.png` in repo root.

**Wordmark:** `BLOODHOUND` — all caps, NHGrotesk Bold. Letter-spacing: `-0.02em`. No glow, no gradient, no decoration. The name does the work.

**Lockup:** Icon left, wordmark right. Vertically centered. 8px gap.

**Sizes:**
- Favicon: 32×32px — icon only, red eye must be visible
- Nav: icon at 20px height + wordmark 16px
- Standard: icon 28px + wordmark 22px
- Hero/landing: icon 48px + wordmark 36px

**Usage rules:**
- Dark bg: white silhouette + red eye
- Light bg (docs pages): black silhouette + red eye
- Never apply a gradient or glow to the wordmark

## 2. Layout & Navigation

### 2.1 Navigation — TOP NAV (CONFIRMED)

Fixed top nav bar. Height: 56px. Full-width.

**Left:** BLOODHOUND lockup (nav size)

**Center:** Universal search bar — ~40% of nav width. Placeholder: `"Search wallet, token, tx, program, @handle..."`. Input border highlights `--accent` on focus.

**Right:** Network status pill (green dot + "Mainnet") | Notifications bell (logged in users only) | Account menu or Sign In.

**Navigation links** (inline within or just below the top bar on desktop):
`Explorer` | `Intelligence` | `Tracked` | `Signals` | `Bloodhound AI` | `API` | `Docs`

**`[PLAN]`** Active nav item: `--accent` text color + 2px bottom border in `--accent`. No filled background tab.

**`[PLAN]`** No persistent left sidebar for global navigation. A contextual right-panel sidebar appears within the Graph view (wallet detail on node click) and within the Tracked Wallets page (wallet list panel).

**Status bar** — fixed at bottom of all app pages, 32px:
`● Mainnet` | `Indexer: synced` | `API: operational` | `Last block: Xs ago`
All `data-sm` font. Muted color unless error/warning state.

---

### 2.2 Standard Page Structure

```
[ Top Nav Bar — 56px, fixed ]
[ Page Header — breadcrumb + page title, ~56px ]
[ Page Content — grows to fill viewport ]
[ Status Bar — 32px, fixed bottom ]
```

Page background IS `--bg-base`. Cards and panels float on it using `--bg-surface` with a 1px `--border`.

### 2.3 Responsive Breakpoints

**`[PLAN]`**
- Desktop: ≥1280px — full multi-column layouts
- Laptop: 1024–1279px — slightly condensed, all features available
- Tablet: 768–1023px — single column, nav collapses to hamburger
- Mobile: <768px — core read-only features (search, wallet view, tx list), graph replaced with table fallback

## 3. Texture & Motion

### 3.1 Texture — CONFIRMED (subtle scanlines + grid)

- **Scanlines:** CSS `repeating-linear-gradient` at ~3% opacity on `--bg-base` only. ~2px lines. Not on cards/panels.
- **Grid:** On hero section only. 1px lines, ~4% opacity, 80px grid. Creates the "command center" feel.
- **`[PLAN]`** Noise: Optional SVG noise at 2% on `--bg-surface` — test and include only if it reads well on target screens without feeling muddy.

### 3.2 Motion System — CONFIRMED (alive, constant subtle motion)

The site should feel like a **live terminal**. Data streaming, nodes pulsing, things subtly moving at all times.

**Tier 1 — Always on:**
- Blinking cursor on active AI input (terminal feel)
- Pulsing network status dot (2s loop, very low amplitude)
- Subtle scrolling ticker for the hero live feed (constant, smooth)
- Pulsing classification badges on wallet profiles (slow, 4s)

**Tier 2 — On data arrival (real-time):**
- New transaction in feed: row fades in from top
- New signal: card slides in from top with subtle flash
- Graph new node: fades in, slight scale-from-zero
- Graph new edge: draws along path from source to target

**Tier 3 — On interaction:**
- Page transitions: **instant** but with quick fade + slide-up (100ms). No dramatic transitions.
- Panel expand/collapse: smooth height animation 150ms
- Button hover: `--accent-hover` shift in 80ms
- Table row hover: background to `--bg-elevated` in 80ms
- Node hover in graph: scale 1.06x + `--accent-glow` ring

**Tier 4 — Graph specific:**
- New transaction arrives: edge briefly pulses red, then normalizes (medium prominence — not aggressive, not invisible. "In between.")
- Expanding hops: nodes radiate outward with physics spring
- Loading graph: skeleton canvas with pulsing placeholder nodes

**`[PLAN]`** Rules:
- `prefers-reduced-motion` must be respected — all animation disabled or simplified when set
- 60fps target for all UI, 30fps acceptable for graph canvas
- No auto-play video anywhere

## 4. Page-by-Page Design Specs

### 4.1 Landing Page

**Goal:** Communicate "serious intelligence tool" in 10 seconds. Drive sign-up or direct app entry.

**Hero — Full viewport height:**
- Background: subtle scanline + grid overlay on `--bg-base`
- **Hero visual (CONFIRMED):** Real-time live data feed visible in the hero — a streaming ticker/feed showing actual KOL transactions and significant wallet movements (large sells on popular meme tokens, big wallet movements). This should feel like Bloomberg terminal data, scrolling live.
- Headline (`display`): **"On-Chain Intelligence for Solana."** — confirmed by owner
- Subheadline (`body`, `--text-secondary`): "Track wallets. Map relationships. Follow the money."
- CTA buttons: `[ Launch App ]` (blood red fill) and `[ Read Docs ]` (ghost/border)
- No waitlist form — goes straight to app (confirmed)

**`[PLAN]`** Live feed in hero: two or three columns of streaming events (KOL wallet activity, large swaps, insider movements), heavily stylized to match the brand. Each row shows wallet label/handle + action + amount + time delta. Rows scroll upward slowly. This demonstrates real product value before the user even signs in.

**Stats strip below hero:**
`12.4M+ Transactions Indexed` | `847K Wallets Tracked` | `Real-time · Solana Mainnet`

**Three feature sections (below fold):**
1. "The Intelligence Layer" — wallet profiling, classification engine, transaction sources
2. "Relationship Mapping" — graph viz screenshot showing connections, bundles, clusters
3. "Bloodhound AI" — AI query demo showing a relationship trace with evidence

**Footer:** Logo + nav links + GitHub + Twitter/X + Docs + `© 2026 BLOODHOUND`

### 4.2 Universal Search & Autocomplete

**Autocomplete dropdown** (appears after 2 chars of input):
- Sections: "Wallets" | "Tokens" | "Transactions" | "Programs" | "Your Tracked Wallets"
- Each result: icon + truncated identifier + secondary label (balance / symbol / type)
- Max 4 per section. "Search @handle" should resolve to associated wallets via Twitter API.
- Instant results from Redis cache (<100ms)

**Full results page** (when user hits Enter):
- Tabs: All | Wallets | Tokens | Transactions | Programs
- Clean list per tab with relevant columns and inline metadata

### 4.3 Wallet Profile Page — CRITICAL

This is the most important page. Every detail must be polished.

**Page Header (full-width card, `--bg-surface`):**
```
[ Classification badges: WHALE  SMART MONEY  SNIPER ]
[ Wallet label/name if known — large, bold ]     [ 4 tracked by 847 users ]
[ @twitterhandle  @telegram ]                    [ ⭐ Track This Wallet ]
[ wallet....address (monospace, click-to-copy) ]
[ SOL balance: 1,284.4 SOL  |  Portfolio: $94,281 USD  |  First active: Jan 12 2024  |  Last active: 4 hours ago ]
[ [ Open Graph ]  [ Bloodhound AI ]  [ Share ] ]
```

**Classification badges** use `--accent` color for active/dangerous types (INSIDER, BUNDLER, WASH TRADER, BOT), white outline for neutral types (DEPLOYER, LP PROVIDER, EXCHANGE).

**Twitter/Telegram handles** — shown if linked in known wallets DB. Clicking opens their profile in a new tab.

**Two-column layout (70/30) on desktop:**

**Left column (70%):**
1. **Intelligence Summary** (AI-generated, 3–4 sentences, collapsible). Shows wallet behavior, strategy, notable patterns. Confidence badge top-right.
2. **Transaction History** (TanStack Table, infinite scroll)
   - Columns: Time | Source (logo) | Type | Token | Amount | Direction | Counterparty | Tx link
   - **Transaction source logos** shown: Axiom, Coinbase, Phantom, Jupiter, Raydium, Orca, Pump.fun, Jito, etc. Logo + name tooltip on hover.
   - Filters: Type | Token | Amount range | Date range | Program | Direction | Success/Failed
3. **Token Holdings** — grid of token cards: logo + name + amount + USD value. Sorted by value.
4. **NFT Holdings** — hidden by default. "Show NFTs" toggle. When expanded: images, collection name, floor price, estimated value.

**Right column (30%):**
1. **Top Counterparties** — top 5 addresses this wallet interacts with. Shows label (if known), total SOL exchanged, last interaction.
2. **Known Connections** — labeled wallets this address connects to, with relationship type.
3. **Potential Side Wallets** — auto-listed when above confidence threshold (no toggle — shown by default with label "Potential Side Wallets"). Shows confidence % + brief reason ("Direct SOL transfer + co-sniped 3 tokens"). Users can click to dispute.
4. **Tracked by** — "Tracked by 847 users" — social proof that helps users discover popular wallets.

### 4.5 Graph View (Relationship Map)

**Full-page view.** Accessible from wallet profile "Open Graph" button or via Intelligence nav.

**Left controls panel (collapsible sidebar):**
- Seed wallet field (auto-populated from context, editable)
- Hop depth: 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 (default: 2)
- Filters: relationship type | min SOL transferred | time range | show/hide exchange nodes
- Layout: Force-directed | Hierarchical | Radial
- "+ Add wallet to graph" for multi-wallet comparison

**Main canvas (G6 v5, WebGL):**
- Background: `--bg-base`
- Default: seed wallet + 2-hop connections (confirmed by owner — "direct connections and their connections")
- Node sizes scale relatively with transaction volume
- Edge thickness scales with SOL transferred
- Edge labels: hidden by default, shown on hover (amount + tx count)
- "Click a connection to see further" — expanding works by clicking nodes to reveal their connections

**`[PLAN]`** Node visual legend:

| Node Type | Color | Shape | Size |
|---|---|---|---|
| Seed / Selected wallet | Blood red fill | Circle | Large |
| Known labeled wallet | White fill, bold label | Circle | Medium-large |
| Unknown wallet | Gray 50% | Circle | Medium |
| Side wallet candidate | Gray 30%, dashed border | Circle | Medium |
| Exchange / Protocol | White fill | Square / Diamond | Medium |
| Bundler cluster | Blood red outline | Circle | Medium |

Edge colors: direct SOL transfer (white), token co-trade (gray), same bundle (red dashed).

**Graph interactions (all confirmed):**
- Click node → opens wallet mini-profile in right sidebar (320px)
- Click edge → shows transaction list between those two wallets
- Right-click node → context menu: "Track this wallet" | "Label this wallet" | "Expand connections" | "View full profile"
- Drag nodes to rearrange

**Right sidebar (on node select):**
- Wallet label/address
- Classification badges
- Relationship to seed wallet ("Funded by seed · 3.2 SOL · Jan 2024")
- Top 3 recent transactions
- "Open Full Profile →" link

**Export bar (bottom):** `[ Export PNG ]` `[ Export CSV ]` `[ Export JSON ]`

**`[PLAN]`** Graph node limit: 300 nodes before clustering kicks in. Beyond 300, minor nodes (low volume, unknown wallets) are grouped into cluster bubbles labeled "N unknown wallets."

**Accessible from Graph View or from the wallet profile.**

**Format (confirmed by owner):** Horizontal time axis + chronological interaction feed + shows tokens bought/sold and PnL.

**`[PLAN]`** Layout:

### 4.7 Bloodhound AI (formerly "Ask the Hive")

The AI feature is named **Bloodhound** — it is the product, not a sub-feature. The AI query interface is the "Bloodhound AI" terminal.

**Agentic:** Bloodhound AI can take actions in the site for you — save a wallet to your tracked list, open a graph, set an alert, run a search — as part of answering your query.

**Layout — full-page query terminal:**
- Top: large input field styled as a terminal prompt. Prefix: `bloodhound >` in blood red monospace. User types after.
- `[ Run Query ]` button or Enter to submit.
- Prior queries appear above as a session history, newest at top.
- Session persists across page navigation within the same tab.

**Response card format (every response includes):**
```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ QUERY: does poop send to punk?                           │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ YES — poop has sent punk 88.7 SOL across 5               │
│ transactions. Last: 14 hours ago (Feb 27, 2026).         │
│                                                          │
│ 88.7 SOL  ·  5 txs  ·  First: Feb 1 2026                │
│                                                          │
│ Evidence:                                                │
│ → 3Xv9a...4kPz   Feb 27  12.4 SOL   [ view ]            │
│ → 9mKQr...8nLp   Feb 21  34.1 SOL   [ view ]            │
│ → [ show all 5 ]                                         │
│                                                          │
│ ● CONFIRMED — Direct on-chain proof found                │
│                                                          │
│ [ Show Graph ]  [ Show Table ]  [ Track poop ]           │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

"Track poop" button — Bloodhound AI takes the action directly, no navigation required.

**Confidence badge styles:**
- `● CONFIRMED` — green dot, green text
- `◐ PROBABLE` — amber dot, amber text
- `○ SUSPECTED` — orange outline, orange text
- `✗ UNKNOWN` — gray, muted

**Multi-turn memory:**
- Remembers all user's tracked wallet labels (from their account) — no need to paste addresses
- Remembers prior questions in the session ("now check the same for punk")
- References prior answers cross-session via user profiles (tracked wallets persist)

**`[PLAN]`** Response time target: 8 seconds max. After 1 second, show pulsing "thinking..." indicator with the bloodhound icon. If >8 seconds, show "Still working — complex query detected."

### 4.8 Tracked Wallets Dashboard

**Two-column layout on desktop:**

**Left panel (35%) — wallet list:**
- Search within tracked wallets
- "+ New Group" button
- Free users: 1 group with max 50 wallets
- Pro users: unlimited groups and wallets
- Each wallet entry: label | truncated address | classification badge | SOL balance | activity indicator (green dot = active today)
- "..." menu: Edit label | Remove | View Profile | View Graph | Set Alert

**Right panel (65%) — feed:**
- Default: live feed of all tracked wallet activity (reverse chronological)
- On wallet select: that wallet's mini-summary + filtered activity
- Feed entry: `[time] [wallet label] [action] [amount] [token] [source logo] → [tx link]`
- Settings gear: filter feed by value threshold, token, action type

**Notification system:** Bell icon in top nav shows unread alerts. In-page notification tray on right side slides in for real-time alerts.

### 4.9 Signals Feed

**`[PLAN]`** Public feed, browsable by all users (anonymous included), with personalization layer (tracked wallet filter) for logged-in users.

**Filterable list/table layout. Not infinite cards — clean rows.**

Signal entry format:
```
[ Icon ]  Abnormal Inflow — dev_wallet received 850 SOL    ● PROBABLE    4h ago
          from an unknown originator.
          [ → View Wallet ]  [ → View Tx ]  [ Track Wallet ]
```

Filters: Signal Type | Confidence Level | Time | "My Tracked Wallets Only" toggle

**`[PLAN]`** Global signals require higher threshold to appear: significant events only (large amounts, known wallet activity, suspicious patterns at scale). Personalized signals (tracked wallet related) can be more granular.

### 4.10 Admin Panel (Internal — Known Wallets Review)

Clean and functional. Not public. Dev access only.

- Queue of pending wallet submissions
- Each submission: address, proposed label, category, evidence images (viewer), evidence text, submitter info
- Actions: Approve | Reject | Request More Info
- On Approve: set final label, category, linked Twitter/X handle, linked Telegram
- Approved wallets immediately visible globally
- Edit/flag existing approved wallets
- Version history log for any wallet (shows all previous labels and changes)

### 4.11 User Profile & Settings

**Account settings page:**
- Profile: display name, email, linked X/Twitter handle (for @handle → wallet connections), linked Solana wallet address
- Notification preferences: toggle each delivery channel (in-app / email / browser push / Telegram / webhook)
- Subscription status: Free / Pro badge, usage metrics, upgrade CTA
- API keys (Pro): generate and manage API keys

## 5. Component Specifications

### 5.1 Core Component List

| Component | Notes |
|---|---|
| `AddressTag` | Monospace, truncated `XXXX...XXXX`, click-to-copy, optional label prefix |
| `ClassificationBadge` | Pill badge: WHALE / SMART MONEY / SNIPER / INSIDER / BOT etc. Accent red for dangerous types, white outline for neutral |
| `WhaleBadge` | Two sub-types: "WHALE WALLET" ($50k+) vs "WHALE HOLDER" (≥1% supply) — distinct labels |
| `ConfidenceBadge` | CONFIRMED (green) / PROBABLE (amber) / SUSPECTED (orange) / UNKNOWN (gray) |
| `TxSourceLogo` | Platform logo (Axiom, Phantom, Jupiter, Raydium, Orca, Pump.fun, Coinbase, Jito) + name tooltip |
| `WalletCard` | Compact tracked wallet list item |
| `TxRow` | Transaction table row with source logo, type icon, amount, direction arrow, counterparty |
| `SignalCard` | Signal feed entry |
| `BloodhoundResponse` | Full AI response card with evidence links and action buttons |
| `NetworkStatusPill` | Status bar pill with pulsing colored dot |
| `SearchBar` | Universal search with autocomplete dropdown |
| `GraphCanvas` | G6 v5 canvas wrapper with controls overlay |
| `TimelineView` | Horizontal time axis + event feed |
| `SocialHandle` | Twitter/Telegram handle chip, links to external profile |
| `PnLBadge` | Green (profit) / red (loss) amount badge for trade results |

### 5.2 Data Display Standards

- All wallet addresses: `XXXX...XXXX` (4+4). Full address in tooltip. Click copies full address.
- SOL amounts: 4 decimal places — `12.4821 SOL`
- USD amounts: 2 decimal places — `$14,284.22`
- Large numbers: K/M/B — `1.2M txs`, `$4.8B volume`
- Timestamps: relative when <24h ("4 hours ago"), absolute when >24h ("Feb 27, 2026 · 14:23 UTC")
- PnL: always show sign — `+$4,821` (green) / `-$1,204` (red)
- Token amounts: full precision for small floats, rounded for large integers

## 6. Empty States & Error States

| State | Copy |
|---|---|
| No search results | "No matches found. Try a wallet address or tx hash." |
| Empty tracked wallets | "No wallets tracked yet. Add one to start following the trail." |
| No graph connections | "No connections found within [N] hops. Try expanding depth." |
| Wallet has no history | "This address has no recorded on-chain activity." |
| Bloodhound AI — no data | "No on-chain evidence found. [UNKNOWN — insufficient data]" |
| API error | "Couldn't reach the indexer. Check status at status.bloodhound.xyz" |
| Loading state | Pulsing skeleton UI (no spinners). Match layout of loaded state exactly. |

## 7. Items Left for UI/UX Agent Discretion

The following are intentionally not specified — they're design judgment calls:

- Exact NHGrotesk weight pairings across all contexts
- Final token/NFT card grid density and thumbnail size
- Mobile-specific navigation pattern (bottom tab bar vs hamburger)
- Exact spacing/padding system (recommend 8px base grid)
- Whether the live feed in hero auto-pauses on hover
- Exact node size formula for graph (volume-relative)
- Animation easing curves (recommend cubic-bezier ease-out for most)
- How many lines of Intelligence Summary are visible before "Show more"
- Whether wallet profile uses sticky right column or scrolls together
